import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
import 'core/store.dart';
import 'core/theme.dart';
import 'screens/onboarding.dart';
import 'shell.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  await Store.init();
  runApp(const UniMateApp());
}

class UniMateApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const UniMateApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder(
      valueListenable: Store.listenable,
      builder: (context, value, child) {
        return MaterialApp(
          title: 'رفيق الجامعة',
          debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
          theme: AppTheme.light(Store.accent),
          darkTheme: AppTheme.dark(Store.accent),
          themeMode: Store.themeMode,
          locale: const Locale('ar'),
          supportedLocales: const [Locale('ar')],
          localizationsDelegates: const [
            GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
            GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
            GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
          ],
          builder: (context, child) => Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
          ),
          home: Store.hasProfile ? const AppShell() : const OnboardingScreen(),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// الهيكل الرئيسي: شريط تنقل سفلي بين الأقسام الأربعة.
class AppShell extends StatefulWidget {
  const AppShell({super.key});

  @override
  State<AppShell> createState() => _AppShellState();
}

class _AppShellState extends State<AppShell> {
  int _index = 0;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: IndexedStack(
        index: _index,
        children: const [
          HomeTab(),
          ScheduleTab(),
          SubjectsTab(),
          SettingsTab(),
        ],
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
        selectedIndex: _index,
        onDestinationSelected: (i) => setState(() => _index = i),
        destinations: const [
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.home),
            label: 'الرئيسية',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
            label: 'الجدول',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.menu_book),
            label: 'المواد',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.settings_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.settings),
            label: 'الإعدادات',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
===FILE: lib/core/store.dart ===
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:hive_flutter/hive_flutter.dart';

/// طبقة التخزين: قاعدة بيانات Hive مشفرة.
/// مفتاح التشفير يُحفظ في مخزن الجهاز الآمن ولا يخرج منه.
class Store {
  Store._();

  static const _keyAlias = 'unimate_db_key';
  static late Box<Map> _box;

  static Future<void> init() async {
    await Hive.initFlutter();
    const secure = FlutterSecureStorage();
    var encoded = await secure.read(key: _keyAlias);
    if (encoded == null) {
      final rnd = Random.secure();
      final bytes = List<int>.generate(32, (_) => rnd.nextInt(256));
      encoded = base64Encode(bytes);
      await secure.write(key: _keyAlias, value: encoded);
    }
    _box = await Hive.openBox<Map>(
      'unimate_db',
      encryptionCipher: HiveAesCipher(base64Decode(encoded)),
    );
  }

  static ValueListenable<Box<Map>> get listenable => _box.listenable();

  static String newId() =>
      DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toRadixString(36) +
      Random().nextInt(9999).toString();

  // ---------- الملف الشخصي ----------
  static bool get hasProfile => _box.get('profile') != null;

  static Map<String, dynamic> get profile =>
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(_box.get('profile') ?? {});

  static Future<void> saveProfile(Map<String, dynamic> p) =>
      _box.put('profile', p);

  // ---------- الإعدادات ----------
  static Map<String, dynamic> get _settings =>
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(_box.get('settings') ?? {});

  static T setting<T>(String key, T fallback) =>
      (_settings[key] as T?) ?? fallback;

  static Future<void> setSetting(String key, dynamic value) async {
    final s = _settings;
    s[key] = value;
    await _box.put('settings', s);
  }

  static ThemeMode get themeMode {
    switch (setting<String>('theme', 'dark')) {
      case 'light':
        return ThemeMode.light;
      case 'system':
        return ThemeMode.system;
      default:
        return ThemeMode.dark;
    }
  }

  static Color get accent => Color(setting<int>('accent', 0xFF6C5CE7));

  // ---------- القوائم (مواد، محاضرات، حضور) ----------
  static List<Map<String, dynamic>> all(String key) {
    final raw = _box.get(key);
    if (raw == null) return [];
    return (raw['items'] as List)
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
        .toList();
  }

  static Future<void> upsert(String key, Map<String, dynamic> item) async {
    final items = all(key);
    final i = items.indexWhere((e) => e['id'] == item['id']);
    if (i >= 0) {
      items[i] = item;
    } else {
      items.add(item);
    }
    await _box.put(key, {'items': items});
  }

  static Future<void> remove(String key, String id) async {
    final items = all(key)..removeWhere((e) => e['id'] == id);
    await _box.put(key, {'items': items});
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic>? subject(String id) {
    for (final s in all('subjects')) {
      if (s['id'] == id) return s;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String subjectName(String id) =>
      (subject(id)?['name'] as String?) ?? 'مادة محذوفة';

  // ---------- الحضور ----------
  static String? attendanceStatus(String lectureId, String date) {
    for (final a in all('attendance')) {
      if (a['lectureId'] == lectureId && a['date'] == date) {
        return a['status'] as String;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  static Future<void> setAttendance(
      String lectureId, String date, String? status) {
    final id = '$lectureId|$date';
    if (status == null) return remove('attendance', id);
    return upsert('attendance', {
      'id': id,
      'lectureId': lectureId,
      'date': date,
      'status': status,
    });
  }

  /// نسبة الحضور لمادة (الملغاة لا تُحتسب). تعيد null إذا لا توجد سجلات.
  static int? attendanceRate(String subjectId) {
    final lectureIds = all('lectures')
        .where((l) => l['subjectId'] == subjectId)
        .map((l) => l['id'])
        .toSet();
    var total = 0;
    var attended = 0;
    for (final a in all('attendance')) {
      if (!lectureIds.contains(a['lectureId']) || a['status'] == 'ملغاة') {
        continue;
      }
      total++;
      if (a['status'] == 'حاضر' || a['status'] == 'متأخر') attended++;
    }
    return total == 0 ? null : (attended * 100 ~/ total);
  }

  // ---------- الحذف المتسلسل ----------
  static Future<void> deleteLecture(String id) async {
    for (final a in all('attendance').where((a) => a['lectureId'] == id).toList()) {
      await remove('attendance', a['id'] as String);
    }
    await remove('lectures', id);
  }

  static Future<void> deleteSubject(String id) async {
    for (final l in all('lectures').where((l) => l['subjectId'] == id).toList()) {
      await deleteLecture(l['id'] as String);
    }
    await remove('subjects', id);
  }

  static Future<void> wipe() => _box.clear();
}
===FILE: lib/core/util.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

const dayNames = ['السبت', 'الأحد', 'الاثنين', 'الثلاثاء', 'الأربعاء', 'الخميس', 'الجمعة'];
const levelNames = ['الأول', 'الثاني', 'الثالث', 'الرابع'];
const termNames = ['الترم الأول', 'الترم الثاني'];
const attendanceStatuses = ['حاضر', 'غائب', 'متأخر', 'ملغاة'];
const difficultyNames = ['سهل', 'متوسط', 'صعب'];
const lectureTypes = ['نظري', 'عملي'];

/// فهرس اليوم: السبت = 0 ... الجمعة = 6
int dayIndexOf(DateTime d) => (d.weekday % 7 + 1) % 7;

String ymd(DateTime d) => DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(d);

/// تاريخ اليوم المقابل داخل الأسبوع الحالي
DateTime dateForDayInThisWeek(int dayIndex) {
  final now = DateTime.now();
  final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
  return today.add(Duration(days: dayIndex - dayIndexOf(today)));
}

int toMin(String hm) {
  final parts = hm.split(':');
  return int.parse(parts[0]) * 60 + int.parse(parts[1]);
}

TimeOfDay parseTime(String hm) {
  final parts = hm.split(':');
  return TimeOfDay(hour: int.parse(parts[0]), minute: int.parse(parts[1]));
}

String fmtTime(TimeOfDay t) =>
    '${t.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${t.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
===FILE: lib/core/theme.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// ألوان التطبيق وأشكاله. الوضع الفاتح والداكن يتبعان اللون الذي يختاره المستخدم.
class AppTheme {
  AppTheme._();

  static ThemeData light(Color accent) => _build(Brightness.light, accent);
  static ThemeData dark(Color accent) => _build(Brightness.dark, accent);

  static ThemeData _build(Brightness brightness, Color accent) {
    final isDark = brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final scheme = ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: accent, brightness: brightness);
    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: scheme,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF11121A) : const Color(0xFFF3F4FA),
      appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
        elevation: 0,
        scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        titleTextStyle: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 24,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
          color: scheme.onSurface,
        ),
      ),
      inputDecorationTheme: InputDecorationTheme(
        filled: true,
        fillColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF232637) : const Color(0xFFF7F8FC),
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          borderSide: BorderSide.none,
        ),
      ),
      navigationBarTheme: const NavigationBarThemeData(
        labelBehavior: NavigationDestinationLabelBehavior.alwaysShow,
      ),
    );
  }
}
===FILE: lib/core/widgets.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// بطاقة موحدة بزوايا دائرية وظل ناعم.
class AppCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppCard({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(18),
  });

  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final EdgeInsets padding;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1C1E2C) : Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.colorScheme.outline.withOpacity(0.15)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(isDark ? 0.3 : 0.06),
            blurRadius: 24,
            offset: const Offset(0, 8),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Padding(padding: padding, child: child),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// عنوان قسم داخل الشاشة.
class SectionTitle extends StatelessWidget {
  const SectionTitle(this.text, {super.key});
  final String text;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 12, 4, 10),
      child: Text(
        text,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 19,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// مربع إحصائية صغير.
class StatTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const StatTile({super.key, required this.value, required this.label});
  final String value;
  final String label;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppCard(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16, horizontal: 8),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Text(
            value,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 28,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(label, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
===FILE: lib/screens/onboarding.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/store.dart';
import '../core/util.dart';
import '../shell.dart';

/// شاشة الترحيب وإعداد الملف الشخصي عند أول فتح.
class OnboardingScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnboardingScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<OnboardingScreen> createState() => _OnboardingScreenState();
}

class _OnboardingScreenState extends State<OnboardingScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _name = TextEditingController();
  final _age = TextEditingController();
  final _university = TextEditingController();
  final _faculty = TextEditingController();
  final _major = TextEditingController();
  String _level = levelNames[1];
  String _term = termNames[0];
  bool _started = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _name.dispose();
    _age.dispose();
    _university.dispose();
    _faculty.dispose();
    _major.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    await Store.saveProfile({
      'name': _name.text.trim(),
      'age': int.parse(_age.text.trim()),
      'university': _university.text.trim(),
      'faculty': _faculty.text.trim(),
      'major': _major.text.trim(),
      'level': _level,
      'term': _term,
    });
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const AppShell()),
      (_) => false,
    );
  }

  String? _required(String? v) =>
      (v == null || v.trim().isEmpty) ? 'هذا الحقل مطلوب' : null;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!_started) return _welcome(context);
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('ملفك الجامعي')),
      body: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          children: [
            TextFormField(
              controller: _name,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'الاسم الكامل'),
              validator: _required,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextFormField(
              controller: _age,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'العمر'),
              validator: (v) {
                final n = int.tryParse(v ?? '');
                if (n == null || n < 15 || n > 80) return 'أدخل عمراً صحيحاً';
                return null;
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextFormField(
              controller: _university,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'اسم الجامعة'),
              validator: _required,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextFormField(
              controller: _faculty,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'الكلية'),
              validator: _required,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextFormField(
              controller: _major,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'التخصص'),
              validator: _required,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              value: _level,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'المستوى الدراسي'),
              items: [
                for (final l in levelNames)
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: l, child: Text('المستوى $l')),
              ],
              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _level = v!),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              value: _term,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'الترم الحالي'),
              items: [
                for (final t in termNames) DropdownMenuItem(value: t, child: Text(t)),
              ],
              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _term = v!),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: _save,
              child: const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                child: Text('ابدأ رحلتك الجامعية', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _welcome(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              const Text('🎓', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 80)),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                'رفيق الجامعة',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 34,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              const Text(
                'نظّم دراستك، واستثمر وقتك، وحقق هدفك.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              const Text(
                'تعمل بياناتك على جهازك فقط، ولا تحتاج إلى إنترنت.',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 36),
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => setState(() => _started = true),
                  child: const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    child: Text('ابدأ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
===FILE: lib/screens/home.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/store.dart';
import '../core/util.dart';
import '../core/widgets.dart';

/// الشاشة الرئيسية: الترحيب وإحصائيات اليوم ومحاضراته.
class HomeTab extends StatelessWidget {
  const HomeTab({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder(
      valueListenable: Store.listenable,
      builder: (context, box, child) {
        final now = DateTime.now();
        final p = Store.profile;
        final name = (p['name'] as String?) ?? '';
        final firstName = name.isEmpty ? '' : name.split(' ').first;
        final todayIdx = dayIndexOf(now);
        final date = ymd(now);
        final nowMinutes = now.hour * 60 + now.minute;

        final lectures = Store.all('lectures').where((l) => l['day'] == todayIdx).toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => toMin(a['start'] as String).compareTo(toMin(b['start'] as String)));

        var attended = 0;
        var absent = 0;
        var remaining = 0;
        for (final l in lectures) {
          final status = Store.attendanceStatus(l['id'] as String, date);
          if (status == 'حاضر' || status == 'متأخر') attended++;
          if (status == 'غائب') absent++;
          if (toMin(l['start'] as String) > nowMinutes) remaining++;
        }

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: Text('أهلاً بك يا $firstName 👋')),
          body: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
            children: [
              AppCard(
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    CircleAvatar(
                      radius: 32,
                      child: Text(
                        name.isEmpty ? '؟' : name.substring(0, 1),
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 26, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 14),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            '${dayNames[todayIdx]} ${now.day}/${now.month}/${now.year}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text('${p['major'] ?? ''} • ${p['university'] ?? ''}'),
                          Text('المستوى ${p['level'] ?? ''} • ${p['term'] ?? ''}'),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(child: StatTile(value: '${lectures.length}', label: 'محاضرات اليوم')),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(child: StatTile(value: '$remaining', label: 'متبقية')),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(child: StatTile(value: '$attended', label: 'حضرت')),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(child: StatTile(value: '$absent', label: 'غائب')),
                ],
              ),
              const SectionTitle('محاضرات اليوم'),
              if (lectures.isEmpty)
                const AppCard(
                  child: Center(child: Text('لا توجد محاضرات اليوم 🎉')),
                )
              else
                for (final l in lectures) _lectureTile(l, date),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _lectureTile(Map<String, dynamic> l, String date) {
    final status = Store.attendanceStatus(l['id'] as String, date);
    final color = Color((Store.subject(l['subjectId'] as String)?['color'] as int?) ?? 0xFF6C5CE7);
    return AppCard(
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 6,
            height: 54,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  Store.subjectName(l['subjectId'] as String),
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                ),
                Text('${l['start']} - ${l['end']}  •  ${l['hall'] ?? ''}'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Text(status ?? 'لم يُسجَّل', style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
===FILE: lib/screens/schedule.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/store.dart';
import '../core/util.dart';
import '../core/widgets.dart';
import 'subjects.dart';

/// الجدول الأسبوعي. المحاضرة تتكرر كل أسبوع، والحضور يُسجَّل لكل تاريخ.
class ScheduleTab extends StatefulWidget {
  const ScheduleTab({super.key});

  @override
  State<ScheduleTab> createState() => _ScheduleTabState();
}

class _ScheduleTabState extends State<ScheduleTab> {
  late int _day = dayIndexOf(DateTime.now());

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder(
      valueListenable: Store.listenable,
      builder: (context, box, child) {
        final date = ymd(dateForDayInThisWeek(_day));
        final lectures = Store.all('lectures').where((l) => l['day'] == _day).toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => toMin(a['start'] as String).compareTo(toMin(b['start'] as String)));

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('الجدول الدراسي')),
          floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
            onPressed: () => _openLectureSheet(),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
            label: const Text('محاضرة'),
          ),
          body: Column(
            children: [
              SizedBox(
                height: 56,
                child: ListView.separated(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                  itemCount: 7,
                  separatorBuilder: (context, index) => const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  itemBuilder: (context, i) => ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(dayNames[i]),
                    selected: _day == i,
                    onSelected: (v) => setState(() => _day = i),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: lectures.isEmpty
                    ? const Center(child: Text('لا توجد محاضرات في هذا اليوم'))
                    : ListView(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                        children: [
                          for (final l in lectures) _lectureCard(l, date),
                        ],
                      ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _lectureCard(Map<String, dynamic> l, String date) {
    final id = l['id'] as String;
    final status = Store.attendanceStatus(id, date);
    return AppCard(
      onTap: () => _openLectureSheet(existing: l),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            Store.subjectName(l['subjectId'] as String),
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
            '${l['start']} - ${l['end']}  •  ${l['hall'] ?? ''}  •  ${l['type'] ?? ''}',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              for (final s in attendanceStatuses)
                ChoiceChip(
                  label: Text(s),
                  selected: status == s,
                  onSelected: (v) => Store.setAttendance(id, date, status == s ? null : s),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openLectureSheet({Map<String, dynamic>? existing}) async {
    final subjects = Store.all('subjects');
    if (subjects.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('أضف مادة أولاً من قسم المواد')),
      );
      return;
    }

    var subjectId = (existing?['subjectId'] as String?) ?? subjects.first['id'] as String;
    var day = (existing?['day'] as int?) ?? _day;
    var start = (existing?['start'] as String?) ?? '08:00';
    var end = (existing?['end'] as String?) ?? '09:00';
    var type = (existing?['type'] as String?) ?? lectureTypes.first;
    final hall = TextEditingController(text: (existing?['hall'] as String?) ?? '');
    final doctor = TextEditingController(text: (existing?['doctor'] as String?) ?? '');

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (sheetContext, setSheet) {
            return Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                20,
                0,
                20,
                MediaQuery.of(sheetContext).viewInsets.bottom + 20,
              ),
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      existing == null ? 'محاضرة جديدة' : 'تعديل المحاضرة',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      value: subjectId,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'المادة'),
                      items: [
                        for (final s in subjects)
                          DropdownMenuItem(
                            value: s['id'] as String,
                            child: Text(s['name'] as String),
                          ),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (v) => setSheet(() => subjectId = v!),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    DropdownButtonFormField<int>(
                      value: day,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'اليوم'),
                      items: [
                        for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++)
                          DropdownMenuItem(value: i, child: Text(dayNames[i])),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (v) => setSheet(() => day = v!),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: OutlinedButton(
                            onPressed: () async {
                              final t = await showTimePicker(
                                context: sheetContext,
                                initialTime: parseTime(start),
                              );
                              if (t != null) setSheet(() => start = fmtTime(t));
                            },
                            child: Text('من $start'),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                          child: OutlinedButton(
                            onPressed: () async {
                              final t = await showTimePicker(
                                context: sheetContext,
                                initialTime: parseTime(end),
                              );
                              if (t != null) setSheet(() => end = fmtTime(t));
                            },
                            child: Text('إلى $end'),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    SegmentedButton<String>(
                      segments: [
                        for (final t in lectureTypes)
                          ButtonSegment(value: t, label: Text(t)),
                      ],
                      selected: {type},
                      onSelectionChanged: (s) => setSheet(() => type = s.first),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    TextField(
                      controller: hall,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'القاعة أو المعمل'),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    TextField(
                      controller: doctor,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'اسم الدكتور'),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 18),
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: () async {
                        if (toMin(end) <= toMin(start)) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(sheetContext).showSnackBar(
                            const SnackBar(content: Text('وقت النهاية يجب أن يكون بعد البداية')),
                          );
                          return;
                        }
                        await Store.upsert('lectures', {
                          'id': existing?['id'] ?? Store.newId(),
                          'subjectId': subjectId,
                          'day': day,
                          'start': start,
                          'end': end,
                          'type': type,
                          'hall': hall.text.trim(),
                          'doctor': doctor.text.trim(),
                        });
                        if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                      },
                      child: const Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                        child: Text('حفظ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (existing != null)
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: () async {
                          await Store.deleteLecture(existing['id'] as String);
                          if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                        },
                        child: const Text('حذف المحاضرة', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
    hall.dispose();
    doctor.dispose();
  }
}
===FILE: lib/screens/subjects.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/store.dart';
import '../core/util.dart';
import '../core/widgets.dart';

/// ألوان المواد المتاحة.
const subjectColors = [
  0xFF6C5CE7,
  0xFF0984E3,
  0xFF00B894,
  0xFFE17055,
  0xFFD63031,
  0xFFF0A500,
];

/// قائمة المواد الدراسية. المواد لا تحتوي على مواعيد اختبارات (تُضاف لاحقاً في قسم الاختبارات).
class SubjectsTab extends StatelessWidget {
  const SubjectsTab({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder(
      valueListenable: Store.listenable,
      builder: (context, box, child) {
        final subjects = Store.all('subjects');
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('المواد الدراسية')),
          floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
            onPressed: () => openSubjectSheet(context),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
            label: const Text('مادة'),
          ),
          body: subjects.isEmpty
              ? const Center(child: Text('لا توجد مواد بعد. أضف أول مادة لتبدأ.'))
              : ListView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  children: [for (final s in subjects) _subjectCard(context, s)],
                ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _subjectCard(BuildContext context, Map<String, dynamic> s) {
    final color = Color(s['color'] as int);
    final rate = Store.attendanceRate(s['id'] as String);
    final details = [
      if ((s['doctor'] as String? ?? '').isNotEmpty) 'د. ${s['doctor']}',
      if ((s['difficulty'] as String? ?? '').isNotEmpty) s['difficulty'] as String,
    ].join('  •  ');
    return AppCard(
      onTap: () => openSubjectSheet(context, existing: s),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 8,
            height: 60,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  s['name'] as String,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                ),
                if (details.isNotEmpty) Text(details),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(rate == null ? 'لا يوجد حضور مسجّل بعد' : 'نسبة الحضور: $rate%'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// نافذة إضافة مادة أو تعديلها.
Future<void> openSubjectSheet(BuildContext context, {Map<String, dynamic>? existing}) async {
  final name = TextEditingController(text: (existing?['name'] as String?) ?? '');
  final doctor = TextEditingController(text: (existing?['doctor'] as String?) ?? '');
  var difficulty = (existing?['difficulty'] as String?) ?? difficultyNames[1];
  var color = (existing?['color'] as int?) ?? subjectColors.first;

  await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    showDragHandle: true,
    builder: (sheetContext) {
      return StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (sheetContext, setSheet) {
          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              20,
              0,
              20,
              MediaQuery.of(sheetContext).viewInsets.bottom + 20,
            ),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    existing == null ? 'مادة جديدة' : 'تعديل المادة',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  TextField(
                    controller: name,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'اسم المادة'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: doctor,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'اسم الدكتور (اختياري)'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: difficulty,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'الصعوبة'),
                    items: [
                      for (final d in difficultyNames)
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: d, child: Text(d)),
                    ],
                    onChanged: (v) => setSheet(() => difficulty = v!),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  const Text('لون المادة', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 12,
                    children: [
                      for (final c in subjectColors)
                        GestureDetector(
                          onTap: () => setSheet(() => color = c),
                          child: CircleAvatar(
                            radius: 18,
                            backgroundColor: Color(c),
                            child: color == c
                                ? const Icon(Icons.check, color: Colors.white)
                                : null,
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  FilledButton(
                    onPressed: () async {
                      if (name.text.trim().isEmpty) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(sheetContext).showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(content: Text('اسم المادة مطلوب')),
                        );
                        return;
                      }
                      await Store.upsert('subjects', {
                        'id': existing?['id'] ?? Store.newId(),
                        'name': name.text.trim(),
                        'doctor': doctor.text.trim(),
                        'difficulty': difficulty,
                        'color': color,
                      });
                      if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                    },
                    child: const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      child: Text('حفظ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (existing != null)
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: () async {
                        await Store.deleteSubject(existing['id'] as String);
                        if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                      },
                      child: const Text(
                        'حذف المادة ومحاضراتها',
                        style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      );
    },
  );
  name.dispose();
  doctor.dispose();
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../core/store.dart';
import '../core/widgets.dart';
import 'onboarding.dart';
import 'subjects.dart';

/// الإعدادات: المظهر، لون التطبيق، الملف الشخصي، مسح البيانات، ومعلومات التطبيق.
class SettingsTab extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsTab({super.key});

  static const appVersion = '1.0.0';
  static const developerName = 'سامي الصلاحي';
  static const developerPhone = '772798471';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder(
      valueListenable: Store.listenable,
      builder: (context, box, child) {
        final theme = Store.setting<String>('theme', 'dark');
        final accent = Store.accent.value;
        final p = Store.profile;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('الإعدادات')),
          body: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            children: [
              const SectionTitle('المظهر'),
              AppCard(
                child: SegmentedButton<String>(
                  segments: const [
                    ButtonSegment(value: 'dark', label: Text('داكن')),
                    ButtonSegment(value: 'light', label: Text('فاتح')),
                    ButtonSegment(value: 'system', label: Text('تلقائي')),
                  ],
                  selected: {theme},
                  onSelectionChanged: (s) => Store.setSetting('theme', s.first),
                ),
              ),
              AppCard(
                child: Wrap(
                  spacing: 14,
                  runSpacing: 10,
                  children: [
                    for (final c in subjectColors)
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () => Store.setSetting('accent', c),
                        child: CircleAvatar(
                          radius: 22,
                          backgroundColor: Color(c),
                          child: accent == c
                              ? const Icon(Icons.check, color: Colors.white)
                              : null,
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SectionTitle('الملف الشخصي'),
              AppCard(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(p['name'] as String? ?? '', style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    Text('المستوى ${p['level'] ?? ''} • ${p['term'] ?? ''}'),
                    Text('${p['faculty'] ?? ''} • ${p['major'] ?? ''}'),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SectionTitle('البيانات'),
              AppCard(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Text('بياناتك محفوظة مشفّرة على هذا الجهاز فقط، ولا تُرسل إلى أي مكان.'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    FilledButton.tonal(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: Colors.red),
                      onPressed: () => _confirmReset(context),
                      child: const Text('مسح كل البيانات'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SectionTitle('حول التطبيق'),
              AppCard(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Text('رفيق الجامعة', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
                    Text('الإصدار $appVersion'),
                    Text('تصميم وتطوير: $developerName'),
                    Text('للتواصل: $developerPhone'),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _confirmReset(BuildContext context) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('مسح كل البيانات؟'),
        content: const Text('سيتم حذف الملف الشخصي والمواد والمحاضرات والحضور نهائياً.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('إلغاء')),
          FilledButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), child: const Text('نعم، امسح')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    await Store.wipe();
    if (!context.mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const OnboardingScreen()),
      (_) => false,
    );
  }
}
